body_markdown:
November 9, 2026


**Dear shareholders & investors,**


I would like to share with you a snapshot of the cash our ships are earning in the current market.


The last 10 spot voyage fixtures of the NAT tankers have an average duration of 60 days with a Time Charter Equivalent (TCE) of about $144,000 per day per vessel.


The highest fixture is $347,000 per day and the lowest is $59,000 per day. These are mainly fixtures related to 4Q 2026. Short term aberrations are expected to continue.


Our cash operating costs are less than $10,000 per day per ship. About 50% of our vessels are currently in the spot market, the balance being employed on solid charters.


Based on the strength of the market for our tankers, I expect that NAT will continue to pay healthy dividends.


Numbers for the third quarter of 2026 will be released on Monday November 30, 2026.


Sincerely,


Herbjorn Hansson
Founder, Chairman & CEO
Nordic American Tankers Ltd[www.nat.bm](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sbooC6a7K4tBypUkyHrgdg3RH75h25No2jceABhcGswef68LlzMf0jZ940HOSFBVKNNqhH8D3RGPP3RV5MAN6Q==)
